title: Core ideas in earth science
description: How the planet works: its layers, moving plates, rocks, air, oceans and climate.

ideas.title: Earth's layers and age
ideas.summary: Earth is a layered planet about 4.5 billion years old, with a thin crust, a rocky mantle and an iron core.

items.q: About how old is the Earth?
Which layer of the Earth lies between the crust and the core?
Which layer of the Earth is liquid metal and generates the planet's magnetic field?
What is the approximate radius of the Earth?

ideas.title: Plate tectonics
ideas.summary: Earth's rigid outer shell is broken into plates that creep past, under and away from one another.

items.q: Which scientist proposed the theory of continental drift in 1912?
What was the supercontinent called that began to break apart about 200 million years ago?
About how fast do Earth's tectonic plates move?
items.a: A few centimeters a year, about as fast as fingernails grow

items.q: In plate tectonics, what happens at a subduction zone?
items.a: One plate sinks beneath another and down into the mantle

items.q: At which kind of plate boundary is new ocean crust made, as along the Mid-Atlantic Ridge?
items.a: A divergent boundary, where two plates move apart

ideas.title: The rock cycle
ideas.summary: Rock is made, worn down and remade, passing between igneous, sedimentary and metamorphic forms.

items.q: Which type of rock forms when molten rock cools and hardens?
In which of the three main types of rock are fossils usually found?
What turns an existing rock into metamorphic rock?
items.a: Heat and pressure that change it without melting it

ideas.title: Atmosphere and oceans
ideas.summary: A thin layer of air and a deep layer of water move heat around the planet and make its weather.

items.q: Which gas makes up about 78% of Earth's atmosphere?
About what share of Earth's atmosphere is oxygen?
In which layer of Earth's atmosphere does nearly all weather take place?
Which gas in the stratosphere absorbs most of the Sun's harmful ultraviolet light?
About what share of Earth's surface is covered by ocean?
What is the difference between weather and climate?
items.a: Weather is the state of the atmosphere at a given time; climate is its average over decades

ideas.title: Carbon and climate
ideas.summary: Greenhouse gases hold heat near the surface, and the carbon dioxide people add is warming the planet.

items.q: What is the greenhouse effect?
items.a: Gases in the atmosphere absorb heat radiated by Earth's surface, keeping the planet warmer

items.q: Which greenhouse gas, released by burning fossil fuels, is the main cause of present-day global warming?
What was the concentration of carbon dioxide in Earth's atmosphere before the industrial era?
By roughly how much has Earth's average surface temperature risen since the late 1800s?
Which process takes carbon dioxide out of the air and stores its carbon in plants?
What are the slow cycles in Earth's orbit and tilt called that set the rhythm of the ice ages?
